name: Temporal Hierarchical Index Tree (THITree)
definition: A data structure for fast isosurface extraction from time-dependent data sets that exploits temporal coherence by storing cells that remain constant throughout a time span only once for that entire span, achieving data reduction and fast retrieval.
summary: The Temporal Hierarchical Index Tree accelerates isosurface extraction from time-dependent volumetric data by storing constant cells once per time span, achieving significant data reduction and efficiency.
